meta.name: Quantum · worst case
meta.regime: Exact Euclidean SVP; model must be specified per entry
meta.rules: Return an exact shortest vector on arbitrary full-rank lattices. The general list allows quantum random access where stated; it is not a no-QRAM ranking. Record classical memory, coherent access and quantum memory assumptions per result. The separate no-QRAM category excludes algorithms requiring quantum access to an exponential database. Publication, source checking and independent proof review are separate metadata.
